answer: Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and burn a unique proof-of-work nonce tied to its identity; sybils must pay fresh stake plus compute per fake identity. A gale of duplicate registrations then costs linearly more than the reward, so rational adversaries stop. Honest agents recover stake after a dune of epochs, while any proven sybil forfeits to the pool and leaves only an ember of reputation. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
